name: garmin-mcp-local
description: Read your own Garmin Connect training and health data. Token-only auth, no password handling.
long_description: Runs from a local checkout you control, over stdio, and talks only to Garmin. Authentication is token-only: run `garmin-mcp-auth` once in a terminal to mint OAuth tokens. The server has no code path that accepts a password. Responses are summarised and stripped of known account identifiers and GPS coordinates before reaching the model. Unofficial: not affiliated with Garmin.

server_path.title: garmin-mcp executable
server_path.description: Absolute path to the garmin-mcp executable inside your virtualenv, e.g. <repo>/.venv/bin/garmin-mcp. Install the project first (see README).

token_path.title: Token storage directory
token_path.description: Where garmin-mcp-auth stored your OAuth tokens. Run that command in a terminal before first use.
